# engram

```go
import "github.com/rou-cru/takt-ai/takt/engram"
```

Package engram keeps memory\-server wiring in one place so every agent target shares the same setup and checks.

## Constants

<a name="ContractSkillID"></a>ContractSkillID is the catalog skill ID for the memory contract.

```go
const ContractSkillID = "takt-memory-contract"
```

<a name="EngramVersion"></a>EngramVersion is the minimum Engram release Takt configures and the one it installs.

```go
const EngramVersion = "2.1.0"
```

<a name="MemorySkillsDir"></a>MemorySkillsDir is the OpenCode V2 directory where skills deploy.

```go
const MemorySkillsDir = ".opencode/skills"
```

## Variables

<a name="ContractSkillPath"></a>ContractSkillPath is the memory contract every agent loads before memory calls.

```go
var ContractSkillPath = path.Join(MemorySkillsDir, ContractSkillID, catalog.SkillFileName)
```
